name: Attention output weight NS
method: After each complete optimizer.step, project every vanilla attention c_proj.weight using five native Muon Polar Express polynomials, then restore its pre-projection Frobenius norm.
scope: All8 attention512x512 output weights only; no QKV/MLP/head/embedding updates beyond original optimizer.
precision: BF16 polynomial GEMMs; FP32 norm restoration and persisted weights. FP64 SVD only in read-only diagnostics outside compiled code.
initialization: Unchanged zero W_o; projection leaves zero zero; shared parameters and RNG identical to baseline.
optimizer: Same MuonAdamW, default LR and moments. Post-step projection does not differentiate or reset/transport momentum. Runs once after all gradient accumulation.
constraint: Approximate scaled orthogonality; no exact rank guarantee, and NS cannot generate absent singular directions. No Muon row equilibration or variance scaling in the weight projection.

diagnostics.correctness: 13 new GPU tests plus4 retained backend regressions
diagnostics.profiles: same GPU, baseline/new twice in reversed order, each20warmup+30timed full steps
diagnostics.resume: 25 -> exit85 -> fresh process50, horizon305176; test exact state/RNG plus next fixed-gradient update
diagnostics.spectra: W_o singular values, energy-entropy effective rank, stable rank, relative orthogonality error; fixed4dev contexts x128 uniformly spaced tokens before/after W_o, centered and uncentered feature effective ranks
diagnostics.log_frequency: initial/resume, steps50/250, every5000 and final. These diagnostic passes are outside timed training.
diagnostics.caveat: Square orthogonal mixing preserves covariance eigenvalues and does not whiten input activations. Improved weight spectrum alone is not evidence of better language modeling.

operations.checkpoint: latest500 overwrite, best separate, exit85 every1800seconds
operations.resources: single Hopper>=22GB; public soft priority with backfill allowed; gate40GB/formal80GB scratch
operations.monitor: Gate->audit/push->one10B->first finite formal training step, then exit

alternative.householder: Discussed only; not implemented or submitted. Exact orthogonal parametrization changes optimization coordinates, requires scale/zero-init handling and optimizer review.
